title: De Novo Generation of Odorant Molecules with Targeted Olfactory Receptor Activation Patterns
abstract: arXiv:2611.30509v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Odor perception arises from a combinatorial code in which each molecule activates a specific subset of olfactory receptors (ORs), and the resulting activation pattern determines the perceived smell. We present a framework for de novo generation of molecules predicted to match target multi-receptor activation profiles. We first construct a panoramic binding matrix over 20 ORs, then cluster it to discover representative activation patterns, and finally formulate a structured selectivity loss, combining pairwise ranking, distribution matching, and complexity constraints, to steer a molecular generator via reinforcement learning. Across nine target profiles of varying complexity, our method achieves high predicted selectivity within 18000 oracle calls and provides the largest gains on profiles that are rare under the prior, especially broad-spectrum and sparse-activator targets.

translated_title: 具有靶向嗅觉受体激活模式的气味分子从头生成
translated_abstract: 气味感知源于一种组合编码机制：每个分子会激活特定的嗅觉受体（OR）子集，由此产生的激活模式决定了所感知到的气味。我们提出了一个从头生成分子的框架，用于生成预测上匹配目标多受体激活谱的分子。我们首先构建了覆盖20个嗅觉受体的全景结合矩阵，然后对其进行聚类以发现代表性的激活模式，最后设计了一种结构化选择性损失函数，结合成对排序、分布匹配和复杂度约束，通过强化学习来引导分子生成器。在九个不同复杂度的目标谱上，我们的方法在18000次oracle调用内实现了较高的预测选择性，并且在先验分布下较为罕见的目标谱上获得了最大的提升，尤其是广谱型和稀疏激活型目标。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于强化学习的气味分子从头生成框架，通过构建嗅觉受体全景结合矩阵、聚类发现代表性激活模式，并采用结合成对排序、分布匹配与复杂度约束的结构化选择性损失，成功生成匹配目标多受体激活谱的分子，在广谱型和稀疏激活型等罕见目标谱上取得了最大提升。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a reinforcement learning framework for de novo generation of odorant molecules matching target multi-receptor activation profiles, combining a panoramic OR binding matrix, clustering of representative activation patterns, and a structured selectivity loss with pairwise ranking, distribution matching, and complexity constraints, achieving the largest gains on rare profiles such as broad-spectrum and sparse-activator targets.
